It uses the same statutory quotation, the same finding by the Secretary after notice and hearing, a list of multiple named drugs, and nearly identical language proclaiming that each listed drug has addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that the finding should take immediate effect. C16 and C01 share the same machinery, but C09 most closely matches the child's plural, list-based structure and wording.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas section 3228 (f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: OPIATE.—The word \"opiate\" ... shall mean any drug ... found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found by the Secretary.","parent_excerpt":"Whereas section 3228 (f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: Opiate. The word \"opiate\" ... shall mean any drug ... found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found by the Secretary.","explanation":"The child reproduces the same statutory passage and legal mechanism with only capitalization and punctuation differences."},{"child_excerpt":"AND Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has addiction-forming and addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately:","parent_excerpt":"AND Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following named drugs has addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately:","explanation":"This is distinctive shared language introducing a multi-drug list in precisely the same position."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs ... has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.","parent_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.","explanation":"The operative proclamation is nearly verbatim; the child merely adds a parenthetical exception tailored to one listed drug."}]}
